messages:
lina: Hey payroll — noticed an oddity on Kieran O. (emp 67890). They moved from CA -> OR effective 2025-07-01 but the Aug payrun still shows CA SDI and 'Portland' muni withheld twice. Also 401(k) contribution in PR-2025-08-210 got applied post-tax instead of pre-tax. Can we do an off-cycle and figure out whether a W-2c is needed?

dan-payroll: Send the payrun id + any screenshots. I'll pull the ledgers and run YTD. Quick Q: did relocation paperwork include a new tax state in ADP/HRIS?

priya-hr: HRIS shows the home address update on 2025-07-02 but the tax location field was left as CA in the bulk import. Relocation ops acknowledged the miss — my bad, should've spot-checked.

ben-cfo: Materiality check: what's the total tax/withhold impact? We only file W-2c if it exceeds thresholds or changes federal/state wage/withhold materially. 

payroll-bot: Requested info: payrun PR-2025-08-210, posted 2025-08-31. Ticket created: OR-2412359000. Status: queued for manual review.

dan-payroll: Quick audit numbers (local preview): 
- Double Portland muni withheld: $58.20
- CA SDI (should be 0): $312.45
- 401(k) treated post-tax increased taxable wages by $1,200.00 (employee pre-tax missed)
Net employee overwithheld (estimated) = $370.65. Employer corrections needed for taxable wage base.

dan-payroll: Proposed remediation steps: 
1) Update HRIS tax location to OR (done by priya).
2) Issue off-cycle reversal/refund for the two muni/SDI items and reclass 401(k) pre-tax. Command I will run: 
```
offcycle_adjust --eid 67890 --payrun PR-2025-08-210 --type multi-corr --items "SDI_REFUND:312.45,PORT_MUNI_REFUND:58.20,401K_RECLASS:1200.00" --notes "HRIS tax location import error, employee moved 2025-07-01"
```

priya-hr: I've updated the HRIS tax location and attached the relocation approval and address change evidence in the ticket. I can request Kieran sign an acknowledgement for the correction.

ben-cfo: If the only federal/state tax totals change is the $1,200 taxable wage bump, that could affect federal withholding slightly. Estimate federal withholding delta ~ $180. Is that above our W-2c threshold? Check with tax counsel.

payroll-bot: Off-cycle request OR-2412359000 created by dan-payroll. Status: pending approval.

dan-payroll: I will prepare the off-cycle and vendor ticket to ADP for W-2 advice. If ADP/tax counsel says we must file a W-2c, we'll notify the employee and collect the signed acknowledgement first.

lina: Thanks — please cc me on the ADP ticket. Kieran is remote, wants clarity before any amended forms.

priya-hr: Will do. Also noted: benefits vendor needs the 401(k) pretax correction so deferrals reflect correctly in benefit reports. I'll open a coordination ticket.

ben-cfo: Target timeline? We need this resolved before year-end runs.

dan-payroll: Targeting off-cycle execution and vendor guidance by 2025-12-10. Will escalate if ADP response delayed.

lina: Appreciate it. Keeping this thread as single source. :white_check_mark:
